+def _component_07():
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+                if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+        k = data["k"]
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+        for chosen in combinations(jobs, k):
+            ids = {job["id"] for job in chosen}
+            if not mandatory <= ids:
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in chosen:
+                counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            events = []
+            for job in chosen:
+                events.append((job["start"], 1))
+                events.append((job["end"], -1))
+            active = 0
+            feasible = True
+            for _, change in sorted(events, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1])):
+                active += change
+                if active > 2:
+                    feasible = False
+                    break
+            if not feasible:
+                continue
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+            selected = tuple(sorted(ids))
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and selected > best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+    return solve
